scope: Public discovery summaries checked against primary sources; incomplete eligibility and billing logic. No member benefits, contracts, participants, prices or clinician approval are verified. Service templates are examples, never installed buyer capabilities.

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — early cardio-kidney-metabolic
pathways.summary: Technology-supported chronic care with outcome-aligned payment; this track addresses hypertension, dyslipidemia, obesity-related criteria and prediabetes.
prerequisites: Confirm qualifying track conditions and baseline measures
Verify participating organization, enrollment availability, patient agreement and applicable overlap rules

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — cardio-kidney-metabolic
pathways.summary: Initial track includes diabetes, chronic kidney disease and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
prerequisites: Verify qualifying conditions and baseline measures
Verify participant, enrollment assignment and overlap restrictions; medication titration alone is not ACCESS enrollment

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — chronic musculoskeletal pain
pathways.summary: An initial chronic musculoskeletal pain track.
prerequisites: Verify qualifying pain criteria and patient-reported measures
Verify participating provider, enrollment and concurrent-service restrictions

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — behavioral health
pathways.summary: Initial behavioral health track includes depression and anxiety.
prerequisites: Confirm track conditions and baseline measures
Verify participant and enrollment; a commercial ACCESS-aligned pledge is not coverage

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — heart failure (announced expansion)
pathways.summary: Published expansion names heart failure; future start date is a routing boundary, not a completed eligibility rule.
prerequisites: Obtain effective heart failure track specification and qualifying criteria
Verify participant, enrollment and outcome requirements

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — COPD (announced expansion)
pathways.summary: Published expansion names COPD; pulmonary rehabilitation is a distinct service pathway.
prerequisites: Obtain effective COPD track specification
Verify participant, eligibility, enrollment and overlap rules

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — substance use disorder (announced expansion)
pathways.summary: Published expansion names substance use disorder.
prerequisites: Obtain effective track rules and clinical assessment
Verify participating organization and enrollment

pathways.name: CMS ACCESS — tobacco cessation (announced expansion)
pathways.summary: Published expansion names tobacco cessation; routine cessation benefits require separate review.
prerequisites: Obtain effective track rules
Verify participant and enrollment

pathways.name: CMS GUIDE — dementia and caregiver support
pathways.summary: Coordinated dementia care, navigation, caregiver education and qualifying respite through model participants.
prerequisites: Verify current beneficiary eligibility, dementia criteria and exclusions
Verify participating organization and alignment
Verify caregiver needs and respite eligibility separately

pathways.name: Medicare chronic care management
pathways.summary: Care planning and coordination for qualifying people with multiple chronic conditions.
prerequisites: Confirm qualifying chronic conditions, consent and care plan
Verify provider, service requirements, billing overlap and cost sharing
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare remote patient monitoring
pathways.summary: Connected physiologic measurements used by a provider to manage an acute or chronic condition.
prerequisites: Verify medical necessity, consent, qualifying device and transmission requirements
Verify setup, management, billing and overlap rules for the service date
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare pulmonary rehabilitation
pathways.summary: A defined rehabilitation benefit with condition and service requirements; a COPD label alone is insufficient.
prerequisites: Verify qualifying diagnosis, severity or applicable post-COVID criteria and referral
Verify program setting, supervision, visit limits and cost sharing
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare cardiac rehabilitation
pathways.summary: Rehabilitation for qualifying cardiac conditions or procedures, including certain stable chronic heart failure cases.
prerequisites: Verify qualifying condition or procedure, stability and detailed coverage criteria
Verify referral, setting, supervision and remaining sessions
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare diabetes self-management training
pathways.summary: Structured diabetes education with referral and training limits.
prerequisites: Verify diabetes diagnosis, written order and qualified training provider
Check initial versus follow-up training and remaining hours
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare medical nutrition therapy
pathways.summary: Dietitian-led nutrition services for qualifying diabetes, kidney disease or recent kidney transplant.
prerequisites: Verify diagnosis, referral and qualified nutrition professional
Check annual hours, additional referral and interaction with diabetes education
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare behavioral health integration
pathways.summary: Behavioral health care integrated with the treating care team.
prerequisites: Verify behavioral health assessment and patient agreement
Verify provider model, monthly service requirements and cost sharing
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare community health integration
pathways.summary: Navigation and coordination for social barriers affecting diagnosis, treatment or access. It does not itself establish a meal or transport benefit.
prerequisites: Verify relevant social need and initial treating-provider visit
Verify trained personnel, service and billing requirements
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare principal illness navigation
pathways.summary: Navigation for qualifying serious, high-risk conditions.
prerequisites: Verify qualifying serious condition, anticipated duration and risk
Verify initial visit, personnel and ongoing service requirements
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Medicare home health
pathways.summary: Qualified intermittent skilled care and therapy at home; homebound and other requirements apply. General household support is not automatically covered.
prerequisites: Verify homebound status, skilled need, certification and plan of care
Verify participating agency, available staff and exact covered services
For Medicare Advantage verify exact plan network, authorization, cost sharing and service arrangements

pathways.name: Commercial plan virtual care — member-specific check
pathways.summary: A public UnitedHealthcare example includes virtual primary, urgent, behavioral and specialty care depending on benefits. It cannot establish another plan's coverage.
prerequisites: Obtain exact employer product, plan year, benefit document and member eligibility
Verify network, state, modality, cost sharing and authorization; public marketing is not a contract

pathways.name: Buyer or plan serious-illness support
pathways.summary: Public serious-illness planning resources motivate a support option. They do not establish a universal virtual palliative care benefit or hospice election.
prerequisites: Obtain actual palliative or serious-illness service agreement and coverage terms
Review goals, symptom needs, clinician scope and consent separately from hospice eligibility

medicare_advantage_context.summary: Original Medicare benefit discovery can inform Medicare Advantage options, but exact plan arrangements require verification. Innovation-model exclusions are separate.
